record: Introduced H.R. 5315, the Fair Artificial Intelligence Realization (FAIR) Act, with Rep. Barry Moore, to require that AI bought by the federal government be truthful and politically neutral.

Introduced the Research and Oversight of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Courts Act of 2026 with Senators Roger Wicker and Peter Welch, creating a 15-member task force to study AI speech-to-text tools in federal courts (bill number not stated in the release).
Introduced the Preventing AI Censorship Act, letting citizens sue federal employees who pressure AI providers to suppress or alter outputs based on viewpoint (bill number not stated in the release).
Sent a letter to Meta's chief executive demanding answers about bacterial contamination of Cheyenne's reuse water system by Meta's data center (the release does not mention AI).
Said at a Powell town hall that she co-sponsored the Ratepayer Protection Act so that data centers do not raise local power rates (the article does not mention AI).

The Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026 (already in the record without a number) is H.R. 7997, introduced 19 March 2026 by Ms. Hageman for herself and Mr. Stauber; the Senate companion by Wicker and Welch is reported as S. 4154 (S. 4154 number seen only in a search summary, not opened).
